title: 01 · 작업용 장갑 슈트
detail: Variant 01 FIELD WEAR: closest continuity to original A but worn like practical armored workwear. Primary helmet has original cream wedge brow and amber visor LIFTED above eyes, visibly real adult face and chin below, fabric collar. Main chest is compact cream segmented ribcage breastplate over dark green fabric work suit, not a huge box. Small angular cream shoulder caps sit flush with normal deltoids; matte sage sleeves and trousers with clear dark cloth elbow/knee gussets. Slim detachable forearm assist bracers fit real glove hands. Human waist has visible utility belt and flexible graphite abdominal fabric, cream thigh-front plates cover only outside surfaces, sage greaves taper close to calf, normal reinforced ankle work boots with small cream toe guards. Short low profile flat back battery and thin external hip-to-knee assist strips. Silhouette reads a worker in protective powered clothing, not robotic limbs. Main hero softly bent elbow rests near belt and lowered sword in other hand. Small helmet closed detail shows same orange window, no face screen. Bottom pose a human deep squat and torso-twisting sword cut. Sheet title exact "01 · 작업용 장갑 슈트".

title: 02 · 밀착 기동 슈트
detail: Variant 02 FLEX MOBILITY: distinctive lean articulated powered suit with strongly visible uninterrupted charcoal textile body core. Half-shell cream armored jacket covers upper chest/back and small clavicle shoulder pads; fitted sage limb panels only at OUTER arms and shins with black fabric clearly visible across inner limbs and side abdomen. Helmet compact cream brow, continuous translucent AMBER visor with real eyes/nose faintly visible behind glass and a normal graphite chin cup, no glowing autonomous robot face. Short flexible collar. Narrow articulated external spine assist sits close down middle back, tiny rectangular mint battery at lower back. Elbow and knee assists are thin side bands, not giant cylinders. Human-sized tactical powered gloves have a single modest back-of-hand plate and actual fingers, running/work boots have ankle articulation and normal human soles, no high heels. No huge V torso or hourglass fetish anatomy. Strong but natural adult athletic fit, practical clothed proportions. One red straight sword, lowered with an anatomically human grip. Action inset a low running lunge showing stretched fabric inner thigh/ankles and a twisting cut with shoulder plate clearance. Helmet-open inset shows adult head inside. Sheet title exact "02 · 밀착 기동 슈트".

title: 03 · 외부 프레임 슈트
detail: Variant 03 EXTERNAL ASSIST: slightly more robust industrial assisted harness, visually a recognizable adult person in sage-and-charcoal workwear surrounded by a LIGHT cream external load-bearing exoframe, distinct from designs 1 and 2. Main head wears close-fitting cream protective helmet with amber short brow visor flipped UP, entire human face/chin visible; no oversized machine head. Cream chest harness forms TWO thin angular side rails around fabric chest, one small sage sternum plate plus fabric and broad waist load belt, not solid robot torso. Modest cream forearm cuffs and external shoulder-yoke sit outside human arms with cloth visible; two slim assist rails along outer hips/thighs ending at knee hinge placed beside actual knee. Legs have sage fabric pants, discrete angular knee/shin protection and very human-looking sturdy boots within small cream heel/toe support brackets; wearer feet clearly enter boots. Back has compact flat power pack between shoulder blades with visible padded shoulder straps, no huge twin engine pods. A single red sword, anatomy remains same size as the wearer, no super-sized limbs. A small rear donning inset shows wearer sliding arms through shoulder straps while frame is open at back, no seated cockpit. Action detail braced two-handed sword stance and crouch show load assist rails following human joints. Helmet/cloth folds and straps make the wearer evident at first glance. Sheet title exact "03 · 외부 프레임 슈트".
